title: Zebra wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,6 38,32 62,32' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <polygon points='50,6 56,18 44,18' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='4' fill='#7cf6ff'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='24' x2='58' y2='24' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='28' x2='60' y2='28' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='30' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='30' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='31' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#b9b9d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='31' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#b9b9d6'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#f2f2fa'/>
  <!-- Zebra stripes on head -->
  <path d='M34 34 Q40 38 36 44' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 34 Q60 38 64 44' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='43' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='43' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#d8d8ee'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='54' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#7a7ab0'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='54' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#7a7ab0'/>
  <path d='M46 60 Q50 63 54 60' stroke='#7a7ab0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='64' width='16' height='8' rx='3' fill='#f2f2fa'/>
  <path d='M43 67 L45 67' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 70 L57 70' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#f2f2fa'/>
  <!-- Body stripes -->
  <path d='M30 78 Q36 82 32 90' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 72 Q46 80 42 92' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 72 Q58 80 54 92' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 78 Q60 82 64 90' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='92' width='7' height='8' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='92' width='7' height='8' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='52' y='92' width='7' height='8' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='62' y='92' width='7' height='8' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='97' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
  <rect x='42' y='97' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
  <rect x='52' y='97' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='97' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
</svg>
